verdict.line: You lose if you eat repeated Q (Ntofo Strikes) pokes and let him reach 6 unpunished; you win if you burst him down in the levels 9-13 window before his tank items finish.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) has a 3.5s cooldown and 450 range, outranging every Riven tool, so he dictates the poke phase and builds toward a pulling shockwave at 2 stacks. Riven's Q (Broken Wings), W (Ki Burst), and E (Valor) cycle down fast enough by levels 9-13 to burst him in one combo before his defensive items complete. The lane comes down to surviving the poke and timing all-ins around his W (Path Maker) cooldown rather than trading evenly all game.

theirWindow.what: The second stack fires a shockwave that pulls you in, dragging you into his W (Path Maker) stun range. Disengage after the first Q lands rather than trading through the second hit.

yourWindow.when: His W (Path Maker) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without Path Maker's charge-up damage reduction and stun, he has no reliable way to lock you down. Commit your full Q-W-E burst combo here.

powerCurve.note: Ntofo Strikes range and slow dominate
Both unlock ultimates, trades stay close
Your combo cooldowns outpace his tank items
All Out damage and tankiness take over

start.why: Sustains you through his Ntofo Strikes poke without needing to recall early.

boots.why: Cooldown reduction shortens the gap between your Q-W-E combo windows.

core.why: Shield plus burst proc punishes him hard the moment you land your full combo.
Armor penetration and slow keep him from kiting away with Footwork after you engage.
Damage-over-time conversion lets you survive his All Out all-in and still win the trade.

situational.when: you keep getting burst down during his all-ins
he keeps landing his knockback engage onto you
the enemy team stacks magic damage alongside him

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through extended trades and heals you back, offsetting K'Sante's constant Q poke in skirmishes.

summoners.why: Teleport resets wave state and lets you punish his cooldowns from off-screen; Flash creates or escapes engage windows around his W stun and R knockback.

playing.title: Track his Q stack count
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit; at 2 stacks he fires a pulling shockwave. Back off after the first hit instead of trading through the second.

playing.title: Wait out his W charge
playing.detail: Path Maker's charge-up reduces damage he takes before the dash-stun. Use E (Valor) to block the dash or simply back away rather than trading into the charge window.

playing.title: All-in when Footwork is down
playing.detail: His E (Footwork) is his main shield and escape dash. Once it's used, commit your Q-W-E burst since he has no way to disengage or shield through it.

playing.title: Save Wind Slash for the finish
playing.detail: R (Blade of the Exile) grants a single ranged Wind Slash — hold it to execute him after he's used Footwork to run rather than opening with it.

playing.title: Don't stand in Ntofo Strikes' line
playing.detail: It's a short line skillshot with 450 range that slows on hit. Break line of sight or juke sideways instead of walking straight at him.

playing.title: Force fights by level 13
playing.detail: Your Q-W-E combo hits peak efficiency in the levels 9-13 window, before his tank items complete and before All Out's healing offsets your damage. Look to fight here rather than farming to full build.

playing.title: Chain autos between Q activations
playing.detail: Auto-attack between each Broken Wings activation to spend Runic Blade charges for extra damage before he can react.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the current mythic-less item system as of patch 16.18.1; verify Eclipse/Serylda's/Death's Dance pricing and K'Sante's All Out numbers against the live patch notes before locking the build.
